author: steven5703
body:
This is my new map, Unknown Tunnel! 
It's called Unknown Tunnel because at first I wanted this to be like an evil science lab, but then the theme kinda just disappeared. So the theme is Unknown. And there's a lot of tunnels.

Made by:
steven5703
NinjaBridge (worldedit g0d)
resepignev (yml)
Special thanks to eric for feedback and suggestions :)

Buidling Rules (regions and that stuffs):
You cannot modify any blocks EXCEPT
 -The monument you're attacking (the monuments you need to break in order to win). So you can't modify the monuments you're defending
 -The very center which has all the iron and that stuff

Model


More Screenies: http://imgur.com/a/CwIu0
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/ldd8mt7jpc0je2l/unknowntunnel.rar
YML: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resepignev/YAML/master/Unknown%20Tunnel/map.yml

  • This is a 4 team DTM (red, Blue, Green, Yellow)
  • Each team has two monuments, each basically opposite from your spawn.
Feedback and thoughts welcome :D
